findings.passage: The Local Government, Elections and Pensions Committee debated Senate Bill 62 , a measure that is aimed at securing Missouri elections by requiring documented proof of citizenship and the removal of individuals from voter rolls who do not identify as citizens of the United States.
findings.note: In his weekly legislative column he describes a committee hearing on SB 62 (proof of citizenship, voter-roll removal) and states its aim. He does not say whether he supports it.
